chunks: Believe in God and His Apostle, and spend of what He has given you as His trustee. And those of you who believe and spend in charity will have a great reward.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of spending wealth as a trustee in Islam according to Surah Al-Hadid?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'mustakhlafeen' (trustees) emphasizes that wealth is a divine amanah rather than absolute ownership, a concept deeply linked to the concept of Khums and the rights of the Ahl al-Bayt. This verse underscores the inseparable link between spiritual conviction (Iman) and practical devotion (Infaq), promising that charitable acts performed with sincere faith yield a 'great reward' in the Hereafter.
